# AnimalSpawn

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/animals/animal_agent.h`](../../../src/logic/animals/animal_agent.h) · Scene / prefab name: `AnimalSpawn` · Described in `data/animal_agents.json`

The scene entity asking for a physical animal: body, params, ranges, gait and how the episode runs.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `body` | `std::string` | A body file, or a species id (the library's bodies folder); required. |
| `params` | `std::string` | Params file under resources/ (default agents/params/animal.params.json). |
| `ranges` | `std::string` | GaitRanges file: commands and demonstration styles (default agents/ranges/walk_basic.json). |
| `gait` | `std::string` | Clip of the kinematic walk: walk, trot or run (default walk). |
| `kinematic` | `bool` | The procedural walk is played on the body (demonstrations); JSON key motion: dynamic \| kinematic. |
| `recording` | `bool` | Observations are recorded walks (demonstrations). |
| `draw` | `bool` | WorldShape entities for WorldView. |
| `view` | `bool` | No end of episode by time. |
| `view_truncate` | `bool` | ... but episodes truncated as in training, and kept (eval). |
| `speed` | `float` | > 0: this command straight ahead, in speeds of the walk clip, instead of draws (default 0). |
| `recording_decisions` | `int` | Recorded decisions per walk (default 300). |
| `warmup` | `float` | Seconds walked before a walk is recorded, plus up to a cycle (default 2). |
| `heading` | `float` | >= 0: recorded walks start with this heading in degrees (0 looks down -z); else drawn (default -1). |
| `soft_depth` | `float` | >= 0: this depth of soft ground in heights instead of the ranges' draw (default -1). |
| `orders` | `bool` | Modes and head offsets drawn next to the commands, the nogail_order sensor on (default false). |

## Notes

Read by AnimalFactory in init (the first entity only); registered by registerAnimalAgents, which rejects an empty body, a motion other than dynamic/kinematic and an unknown gait. AnimalBot keeps a copy (spawn).

## Side effects of those systems

- **[AnimalFactory](../systems/AnimalFactory.md)**
  - Reads the body file, the params file and the ranges file (params and ranges hashed with SHA-256); throws AssetError when one is missing.
  - Creates the ragdoll's Jolt bodies and constraints; destroys them in finish.
  - Creates one entity per segment shape when draw is set.
  - Logs an error without an AnimalSpawn, a warning when a routed reset finds no spawn point in the slope band.
